features.title: Visual damage and guard resolve at contact
features.acceptance: Displayed health, wounds and guard retain pre-contact values during windup/travel, then update at impact, without delaying or changing simulation. Cover enemy hits, player hits, counter/riposte, terminal flow, queue, reduced motion and fast-forward.
